info.title: dotnet-bpa - C# best-practice analyzer
info.description: A Roslyn-powered CLI that analyzes C# code for best-practice issues (async void, blocking on async, empty catch blocks, public mutable fields) with SARIF output and optional AI-assisted review.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Also write results to a SARIF v2.1.0 file.

options.name: --ai
options.description:
Run an optional AI-assisted review (requires
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable).

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
EXIT CODES:
0   No error-severity issues.
1   One or more error-severity issues found.
64  Usage error.
66  Input path not found.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .cs file or a directory to analyze recursively.
